description: Explain one check: what it tests and how, why it matters, how to fix a failure, and references (RFCs, MCP specification). Use it after a scan to help the user fix a failing or inconclusive check, or to answer a question about one check. Sends no request. Returns an error for an unknown ID; list_checks gives the valid ones.

id.description: Check ID, with or without the MAP- prefix, case-insensitive: MAP-RTK02 or rtk02. Families (RTK) are not accepted here.

name: explain_check
title: Explain a check
